title: 3 Stocks to Watch on Thursday: FedEx Corporation (FDX), Jabil Circuit, Inc. (JBL) and Williams-Sonoma, Inc. (WSM)
主要内容: FedEx Corporation (FDX) shares rose on Wednesday following the release of better-than-expected fiscal third-quarter results. The company reported earnings per share of $2.51 on revenue of $12.7 billion, exceeding Wall Street estimates of $2.34 per share on $12.38 billion. The revenue growth was driven by increased demand for its services, strong sales in its ground business, and lower fuel and currency exchange rates. FDX shares were expected to open 5% higher on Thursday, continuing a 10% rebound from a mid-February decline. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. (WSM) shares also declined in premarket action due to earnings performance. The company reported fourth-quarter earnings of $1.55 per share and revenue of $1.59 billion, both slightly below estimates of $1.58 per share and $1.62 billion, respectively. First-quarter earnings guidance of 48 to 52 cents per share also missed the Street's expectation of 55 cents. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include JBL.
